nodes.label: BaseViewModel
nodes.rationale: Machine is the source of truth; BaseViewModel assigns published state only from machine after success; machine stays private.

nodes.label: StateMachineV2
nodes.rationale: Not the required production API; reserved/experimental.

nodes.label: ViewModelStateMachine
nodes.rationale: Separates data from orchestration (SRP); transitions belong to the machine, not the state marker.

nodes.label: ViewModelV2
nodes.rationale: Not the required production API; reserved/experimental.

nodes.label: TabViewModelImpl
nodes.rationale: TabsObserver stays on the impl as an input adapter, not part of the kit consumer API.

nodes.label: Actionable
nodes.rationale: Retired sync transition ownership for WebView states.

nodes.label: WebPageLoadingAction
nodes.rationale: Legacy view command bus kept temporarily for migration.

nodes.label: WebViewModelImpl
nodes.rationale: Aligns WebView with the kit's async/throws model and avoids carrying sync transition debt into the new machine.

nodes.label: OpenSpec Workflow
nodes.rationale: Artifact-driven workflow for structured changes; spec-driven schema: proposal → specs → design → tasks.

nodes.label: CacheEntry<Value>
nodes.rationale: A generic CacheEntry enum is domain-agnostic and keeps the state machine (in-flight task vs ready value) reusable and testable in isolation.

nodes.label: TabsDataService
nodes.rationale: Selection-policy agnostic; selection policy moves to AddTabUseCase/CloseTabUseCase.

nodes.label: Acyclic Use-Case Dependency Graph
nodes.rationale: Keep the use-case dependency graph acyclic; composition is allowed and preferred for orchestration.

nodes.label: Encapsulation Principle
nodes.rationale: Instead of static functions for unrelated types, use extensions/instance functions on input/output types to follow encapsulation; file-only helpers stay in that file.

nodes.label: Strategy Design Pattern
nodes.rationale: Use strategy design pattern when a switch statement has more than 1 case and the handling is not short/trivial.

nodes.label: Swift Testing Framework
nodes.rationale: Use Swift Testing framework for new unit tests instead of XCTest.

nodes.label: SwiftLint Rules
nodes.rationale: Use swiftlint rules for *.swift files; project rules file is at catowseriOS/.swiftlint.yml.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: Knowledge graph with god nodes, community structure, and cross-file relationships; query/path/explain return scoped subgraphs.

nodes.label: Graphify Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge; if unsure use AMBIGUOUS; always show token cost; never hide cohesion scores.

nodes.label: cotton-base
nodes.rationale: Shared Kotlin Multiplatform dependency needed for the Xcode project.

nodes.label: Extraction Confidence Rubric
nodes.rationale: EXTRACTED edges are 1.0; INFERRED edges use 0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55; AMBIGUOUS edges use 0.1-0.3.

nodes.label: Graphify Extraction Subagent Spec
nodes.rationale: Defines node ID format, confidence rubric, and JSON schema for semantic subagents.
